content:
jess: Heads-up — bazaar17b int4 canary is getting OOMs on prefetched sessions. Started at 09:12 UTC. Logs below.

mohit: can you paste the error + which host/pool?

jess: ```Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/runtime/infer.py", line 423, in handle_request
    allocate_kv_cache(req)
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.
GPU0 free: 432MB, required: 1.2GB
Model: bazaar17b-int4, batch_size=4, max_new_tokens=512, kv_prefetch=true
... alloc failed in allocate_kv_cache()```

tara: hunch: int4 quant + kv prefetching + default max_new_tokens=512 is too aggressive for 24GB cards. Suggest drop max_new_tokens -> 256 and enable slot-reserve 0.4 for canary. Also try kv_trim_threshold=0.6

leo: agreed. can we try soft-fallback to int8 when allocation fails? We have fallback path but it's noisy. Suggest config: 
```
model_variant: bazaar17b-int4
batch_config:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  max_batch_size: 2
defaults:
  max_new_tokens: 256
  kv_prefetch: true
  kv_trim_threshold: 0.6
  slot_reserve: 0.4
fallback_chain:
  - bazaar17b-int8
```

jess: deployed the config to canary pool r-ml-canary-7.

infra-bot: Deployment request accepted for r-ml-canary-7 by jess at 09:25 UTC — rolling out 3 nodes.

simon: i'll watch SLO and OOM alerts. If OOM rate > 5% in 10m we rollback. Also can we run a quick bisect to see which sequence length triggers OOM? run: `./tools/generate_sweep --model bazaar17b-int4 --n=100 --len-range 64:1024`

mohit: started that sweep on canary nodes. Initial results: failures cluster when prompt_len + max_new_tokens > 2048, and when batch_size>2.

tara: ok that matches. Proposed immediate defaults: max_new_tokens=192, batch_size cap 2, and enable adaptive-window eviction for KV.

jess: i'm going to push those to canary now. Also adding a short-run quality check to ensure quant degrades <1% on our eval set.

leo: keep an eye on latency — slot_reserve 0.4 increased p95 by ~6ms in prior experiments. acceptable.

simon: action items: (1) jess push config to canary + start sweep (2) mohit collect OOM traces + kv usage (3) tara prepare rollback playbook for auto-fallback to int8 (4) leo prepare perf dashboard tile. I'll set an alert for OOM rate.

jess: done — config pushed at 09:42 UTC. sweep started. Will post results in thread.

mohit: sweep partial: 100 runs, 6 OOMs at peak tokens ~2300 with batch 3. With new defaults (max_new_tokens=192, batch cap 2) OOMs=0/100. Logs attached (truncated).

jess: great. We'll keep canary for 2h then promote. Thanks team :shipit:

tara: follow-up: schedule quant-retrain eval for int4 delta on 500-example prompt set tomorrow AM.

leo: noted. will add perf/latency comparison to the rollout checklist.

infra-bot: Alert: OOM rate exceeded threshold in r-ml-canary-6 at 09:30 UTC — auto-rollout paused. (was recovered)

jess: closing loop — canary stable after changes. moving to promote plan.
